note: V90SignBitsExtractor's constructor and destructor.  The destructor's body is empty -- its twenty-two bytes are the compiler's call to the member's destructor -- so the only thing to break in it is to make it do something, which the fourth mutation does.  The other three are the constructor's three stores, and the capacity of six is the one number in the class that is not a zero.
